title: Duplikatwarnung innerhalb der eigenen Organisation
description: As a developer, I want to be warned when a similar prompt already exists in my organisation, so that I reuse instead of duplicating work.

acceptance_criteria.given: the own organisation already owns a prompt with almost identical content
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer creates a prompt with very similar content
acceptance_criteria.then: the scan result contains a duplicate warning listing up to five similar prompts with title and similarity score
and: the creation itself is not blocked
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-017-duplicate-detection.feature: A near-duplicate produces a warning with matches

acceptance_criteria.given: an identical prompt exists in another organisation only
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer creates the prompt in their own organisation
acceptance_criteria.then: the scan result contains no duplicate warning and no hint about the foreign prompt
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-017-duplicate-detection.feature: Identical content in another organisation produces no warning

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt of the own organisation is only loosely related
acceptance_criteria.then: the scan result contains no duplicate warning
and: the threshold is configurable per organisation
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-017-duplicate-detection.feature: Similarity below the configured threshold produces no warning
